lines.zh: 空甲里没有身体，只有脚步
lines.en: There is no body in this armor, only footsteps.
My greaves come down on the flagstones.

lines.zh: 长矛比我高，我扛在肩上
lines.en: The spear is taller than I am; I carry it on my shoulder.

lines.zh: 甲片之间透着一点暗光
lines.en: A dim light shows between my plates.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方灰会散开
lines.en: Dust parts where I pass.

lines.zh: 头盔里空空的，我却看得见
lines.en: The helm is empty, yet I can see.
My shadow is not shaped like a man.

lines.zh: 我一步一步巡视这条走廊
lines.en: I walk the corridor step by step.
My spear tip scores a shallow line.

lines.zh: 关节处没有皮肉，只有机关
lines.en: There is no flesh at my joints, only mechanism.

lines.zh: 我的矛在地面拖出一道痕
lines.en: My spear drags a line across the floor.

lines.zh: 我从一扇门前走过，门自己开了
lines.en: I pass a door and it opens by itself.
I stand still and the armor makes no sound.

lines.zh: 长矛竖在身侧，矛尖朝上
lines.en: The spear stands at my side, point up.
My helm turns slowly to one side.
There is no breathing in this armor.
Candlelight lies on my breastplate.
I wait for someone to come near.
An empty sleeve sways in the wind.

lines.zh: 我握矛的手收紧了一点
lines.en: My grip on the shaft tightens a little.
I set the spear's butt on the stone.
Only one shadow on the wall.
My helm slowly squares up.
There are no eyes behind the visor.
You stand on my spear line.
I lower the point a little.

lines.zh: 谁把我留在这里，我记不清
lines.en: I cannot recall who left me here.
You carry the warmth of the living.
I shift the spear to my other hand.

lines.zh: 我往前踏了半步，石板响
lines.en: I take half a step and the stone answers.
It has been long since I had an opponent.
I lower my head, visor toward you.
There is an old split in my plate.
The weapon you hold is too short.

lines.zh: 我的胸甲凹了一块进去
lines.en: My breastplate has caved in a little.

lines.zh: 我退了半步，甲响了一声
lines.en: I give half a step and a plate rings.
The spear tilts; I set it straight.
The dim light flickers, then holds.
My helm tips to one side.

lines.zh: 我的甲上多了一道新痕
lines.en: A new mark is added to my plate.
My empty hand clenches once.
I brace the shaft against the floor.

lines.zh: 我的甲缝里透出一点暗光
lines.en: A little dim light shows at my seams.
I give half a step and reset my stance.
I do not eat, yet I remember hunger.
You raise what is in your hand.
There is no stomach in this armor, only hollow.
I lower my head slowly to look.
Such a thing will not move me.
Keep it for yourself.
I tip my head slightly.
I raise a hand, the palm hollow.
I turn to leave, then stop.

lines.zh: 那味道让我想起活着的日子
lines.en: That smell reminds me of being alive.

lines.zh: 我们撞上，甲片响成一片
lines.en: We collide and the plates ring.

lines.zh: 你撞在我的胸甲上，退了
lines.en: You hit my breastplate and recoil.

lines.zh: 我一侧身，让你过去半个
lines.en: I turn and let you half pass.
My pauldron is hard, and cold.
The shaft comes across between us.

lines.zh: 我没有移步，是你自己撞来
lines.en: I did not shift; you came into me.

lines.zh: 你的膝盖撞在我的护胫上
lines.en: Your knee meets my greave.

lines.zh: 我的甲面把你的推力卸开
lines.en: My plate sheds your push.

lines.zh: 我退开半步，矛还没放下
lines.en: I give half a step, spear still up.

lines.zh: 我们的影子在地上叠了一下
lines.en: Our shadows overlap for a moment.
Another suit stands at the corridor's end.

lines.zh: 我们面对面，谁也没有脸
lines.en: We face each other, neither with a face.

lines.zh: 它的矛和我的矛碰了一下
lines.en: Its spear touches mine.

lines.zh: 空甲之间也能认出同类
lines.en: Even empty armor recognizes its own.
We turn toward the door together.
We walk the corridor together.
Its armor is older than mine.
Neither of us needs to breathe.
We stop at the door together.
Two spears lean together.
I bend and my plates stack.
My gauntlet takes it.

lines.zh: 我举到面甲前，看了一会儿
lines.en: I hold it before my visor a while.
My fingers do not bend easily.
I put it back where it was.
I draw it nearer with the shaft.
It is hard to pinch in a gauntlet.
I look a long while before I recognize it.
I tuck it inside my breastplate.
I drop it again.
My visor is square to you.
The spear rises to shoulder height.
I draw my rear foot back half a step.
The dim light in the armor flares.

lines.zh: 你退也没有用，我不用喘气
lines.en: Retreat will not help; I do not tire.

lines.zh: 我的矛尖对应你的喉咙
lines.en: The point lines up with your throat.
I slowly shift my weight forward.

lines.zh: 你站的地方石板裂了一道
lines.en: A crack opens in the stone where you stand.
I am patient; I can wait.
I lower the visor.
The dim light inside brightens.
I count your breaths.
You go left; my spear goes left.

lines.zh: 这一片走廊只有我们两个
lines.en: Only the two of us in this corridor.

lines.zh: 我一步一步压上去，不快
lines.en: I press forward step by step, not fast.

lines.zh: 矛尖始终对着你的胸口
lines.en: The point stays level with your chest.
You circle the pillar; I turn with you.

lines.zh: 我的脚步在走廊里回响
lines.en: My steps echo down the corridor.

lines.zh: 我不喊，喊了会惊动别的
lines.en: I do not shout; it would wake the others.

lines.zh: 我的影子贴在你的影子上
lines.en: My shadow lies over yours.
I move along the wall so you cannot circle.
You step back; I take one forward.

lines.zh: 我的脚步不重，可石板在响
lines.en: My steps are light, yet the stone answers.

lines.zh: 我把矛尖贴着你的影子移
lines.en: I move the point along your shadow.
I make no sound, only the armor.
You shut a door; it is not stout.
I stay directly before you.
You have changed direction three times.
My shadow reaches your feet first.
I calculate how many steps you have left.
You back to the end, and it is wall.
The spear thrusts straight out.
I drop the point to hook your leg.
The shaft sweeps and parts the air.
I drive my pauldron into your chest.

lines.zh: 你一挡，我立刻收矛再刺
lines.en: You block; I recover and thrust again.
My gauntlet smashes your hand.
I bring the shaft across into you.
I miss and recover fast.
My shaft sweeps your waist.
I drive my helm into your face.

lines.zh: 你格开一矛，第二矛到了
lines.en: You parry one; the second arrives.
I drive a knee into your gut.

lines.zh: 我的矛尾砸在你的脚上
lines.en: My spear butt hits your foot.
I give half a step and lower again.

lines.zh: 你抓着我的矛，我拧腕抽回
lines.en: You grab my spear; I twist and pull it free.
My plate edge rakes your hand.

lines.zh: 这一下我用了整个身体的重量
lines.en: This blow carries the weight of the armor.
You are thrown far back.
Iron sounds in the corridor first.
I step out of the shadow.

lines.zh: 甲片一节一节亮起暗光
lines.en: The plates light dimly one by one.
The spear lifts from the ground.
I settle, visor forward.

lines.zh: 空甲里没有人，可我在看
lines.en: There is no one in this armor, yet I am watching.
Armor sounds at the corridor's end first.
I step from behind the door.
My spear is taller than the door frame.
The dim light kindles in the seams.

lines.zh: 地上的灰被我的脚步带起
lines.en: Dust lifts at my steps.

lines.zh: 我站定了，面甲对着门口
lines.en: I settle, visor toward the door.
Fire heats the empty armor, hotter within.

lines.zh: 我从台阶上摔下，甲片散了一地
lines.en: I fall down the steps and plates scatter.

lines.zh: 水灌进空甲里，我越来越沉
lines.en: Water fills the empty armor and I grow heavy.

lines.zh: 爆风把我掀翻，甲片飞出去
lines.en: The blast flips me and plates fly off.
An arrow lodges in my seam.

lines.zh: 那股力量在甲里转，找不到人
lines.en: That force circles inside the armor, finding no one.

lines.zh: 我不吃东西，可这具甲在空转
lines.en: I do not eat, yet this armor idles hollow.

lines.zh: 雷顺着长矛走，甲里全是光
lines.en: Lightning runs down the spear; the armor fills with light.

lines.zh: 脚下的石板没了，我一路坠
lines.en: The flagstones are gone; I fall.
